title: Formal-Methods Invariant Checking for Refusal Behavior

original_idea.body:
# Formal-Methods Invariant Checking for Refusal

**Problem:** Refusal invariants are validated only by spot-checks, not systematic checking.

**Direction:** Specify safety invariants as input-transformation families and exhaustively check over a bounded grammar; report violation coverage per class.

**Why it matters:** Moves refusal evaluation toward systematic invariant coverage. Inference-only.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2312.06056; arXiv:2511.02108; arXiv:2510.02712.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Systematic invariant coverage hardens refusal evaluation beyond anecdotal red-teaming.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Bounded transformation grammar plus inference checks; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused invariant-coverage; needs transformation grammar and probe set.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models, inference-only; independent-friendly monitoring infrastructure.

novelty.reasoning: Transformation-based refusal testing exists; bounded-invariant-coverage framing may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Transformation-based refusal testing exists; invariant-coverage framing may be open.
